main_body: A 4x3 block of riveted blue-grey metal panel tiles. It reads as a flat floor or wall plate, not a standing object.
top_band: none. This is a terrain tile, not a standing object. Each panel has a 1-2 row lighter bevel along its top edge, but it is a bevel, not a horizontal surface.
evidence: The kind is terrain (floor or wall autotile block), so the standing-object top-plus-front contract does not apply. The tiles are flat repeating panels with no object volume to fail. The inset hatch frame and bevelled edges are drawn consistently as surface detail. No receding side faces appear.

style.evidence: The ramp is clean: a light bevel, mid, dark and deep navy, plus a cyan accent. The outlines are navy-tinted and match the material, not neutral black. Weaknesses: the panel interiors contain several flat areas of about 6x6 px of a single mid-tone. The only texture is a few rivet dots and sparse corner specks. All 12 tiles repeat near-identical panels, so each tile carries only about 5-6 colours. The Beodeul paving reference has per-stone shading and grain and is richer. The piece reads as a smooth, thinner panel set next to it.
